warnings.message: The role plugin is shared to everyone; group targeting needs Enterprise.
warnings.fix: Keep the role plugin free of anything other roles must not see, or move to Enterprise.

warnings.message: Claude.ai on the web with no device management gets no managed settings and no hooks.
warnings.fix: Put the guardrails in connector tool permissions and skills, and tell the customer what cannot be locked.

warnings.message: The governance log is a Claude Code hook, so a twin on the web has none.
warnings.fix: Record use from the usage dashboard and the source systems' own audit, and say so in the design.

warnings.message: This plan has no audit log and no Compliance API.
warnings.fix: Rely on the source systems' own audit logs, or move to Enterprise.

warnings.message: Confidential data on Team is acceptable only where the audit need is lower.
warnings.fix: Confirm with the customer's compliance owner that the lower audit need holds.

warnings.message: The HubSpot connector needs approval from a HubSpot Super Admin (or a user with App Marketplace access) as well as an Owner.
warnings.fix: Name the customer's HubSpot Super Admin, or a user with App Marketplace access, in the profile's owners and book the approval.

warnings.message: The task reads untrusted input while personal memory is wanted. Memory on claude.ai is one org-wide switch, so it cannot be turned off for this task alone: the task's skill must write nothing to memory, and only controlled steps write it.
warnings.fix: Keep role knowledge in reviewed skills and build the task so it never writes memory; if the org cannot keep memory writes to controlled steps, ask the Owner to switch memory off org-wide.

warnings.message: Page 10 requires custom retention for confidential data, and the profile's retention is standard.
warnings.fix: On Enterprise, set custom retention for the org. On Team, where custom retention is not offered, record that the customer accepts standard retention, under which, page 10 says, "otherwise local sessions are kept 6 years".

warnings.message: A system on a private network must be reachable from Anthropic's IP range, allowlisted at the edge.
warnings.fix: Have the customer allowlist 160.79.104.0/21 at the edge before the task is built.

warnings.message: Claude Tag on confidential data belongs only in scoped private channels.
warnings.fix: Run the routine in a private channel limited to the team.

warnings.message: Whether the Slack directory connector can post is Unverified; post through Claude Tag or the Slack MCP server.
warnings.fix: Post through Claude Tag or the Slack MCP server, not the directory connector.
